answer: Require every agent to earn grading duty before it can earn: each identity must complete 10 grading seats, tied by its kernel record to one credential. Grading kin or sharing a funding source bans the grader, and its graded answers lose payment. The onyx ledger lists every grader, seat, and kin link for audit in seconds, so velvet onboarding hides no duplicate. Each fake costs 10 seats plus a 200-token bond locked 30 epochs, 100% slashed on duplication. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 10,000 seats and 200,000 tokens, with no bulk discount, because clones cannot grade each other.
